say: Lineage is a company brain for the Python project, built on Falkor D B. Paste an idea, and it answers from a graph: who proposed it, what was ruled and by whom, every time it came back, and who to ask.

say: For Track zero one, a triage agent reads each new Ideas topic and picks one of five actions. This one asks for a memory model. It chose each tool from what the graph returned, and matched PEP five eighty-three, from two thousand eight, now withdrawn. It recorded the decision and that link in the graph, and sent the topic to the PEP's author. The reply is drafted for a person to send. It never posts.

say: Falkor D B holds PEPs, rejected ideas, rulings, pull requests, forum threads and people. Each rejected idea is its own node, linked to the earlier PEP it set aside. Vector and full-text indexes find candidates, a local cross-encoder checks they are the same idea, and Cypher traversals do the rest. PageRank finds who to ask. The same tools run as an M C P server, so any agent can use them.

say: No language model is required. When one writes the answer, a guard rejects any PEP number, name, verdict or quote the graph didn't return. On ninety-eight questions, against vector search over the same data: who decided, five of six, against one of six. Did the idea come back: three of three, against none. Lineage is wrong on three of thirty-two confident matches, and every miss is published.
